sourceChanged: YES. Hardening: lib/rate-limiter.ts. Scope correction: member dues initiation gated by lib/dues/member-dues-flag.ts (three routes), capability registry note. New operator tools in scripts/production/ (first-admin, restore preparation, go-live smoke). No schema authority change.
disposition: No unfinished application or security engineering remains for launch scope. Every remaining gate is a human decision, provider action or infrastructure operation. The infrastructure template is compiled and linted but has not been deployed.

digests.PRODUCTION_IMAGE_STATUS: NOT BUILT, deliberately. NEXT_PUBLIC_* values are baked at build time, so production needs its own image, and the release image must come from CI on the merged branch (R-7); a local build of an uncommitted tree would be a meaningless digest. The exact build inputs are in the README. The digest proven on staging is STAGING_PROOF_IMAGE.

evidenceThisPass.RESEND_ENVIRONMENT_ISOLATION: PASS: staging-specific send-only key created through the Resend API (cannot manage keys); production key versions disabled in nzila-staging-kv and replaced in the staging app secret; fingerprints differ; delivery through the app recorded as sent.
evidenceThisPass.RATE_LIMITER_FAIL_CLOSED: PASS on staging: Redis down returned 409 (handler ran) before the fix and 429 after; control with Redis up returned 409.
evidenceThisPass.RATE_LIMITER_RECOVERY: PASS on staging (revision r13, no app restart): Redis down -> explicit limit 429, org-scoped read 200 in ~2s; Redis back -> limiter passed again 26s later. Go-live smoke 16/16 on the same image.
evidenceThisPass.PITR_RESTORE_DRILL: PASS: restored nzila-ue-v2-staging-db to a new server in 7m11s; 695 tables, 1,223 policies, 134 functions, 2,187 indexes and 694 RLS tables matched the source; restored data stopped exactly at the restore point (6 later organizations and 4 later users absent); scratch server deleted.
evidenceThisPass.BICEP: main.bicep compiles and lints with 0 warnings; no secret literals; not deployed and not what-if-validated (needs a target resource group).
evidenceThisPass.ALERT_QUERIES: Calibrated on the staging logs: 5xx (500 x2, 502 x6), Redis (7), Resend (2), database (9), Stripe webhook (5). No log signal exists for ClamAV outage or dead-lettering, so metric alerts and a DB check are used.
evidenceThisPass.GO_LIVE_SMOKE: scripts/production/go-live-smoke.ts: 16/16 on the final staging image (unauthenticated and authenticated modes).
evidenceThisPass.REGRESSION: FINAL pnpm test:fast on the exact frozen source: 38,285 tests passed, 0 failed, 114 skipped (2,283 files passed, 13 skipped); typecheck PASS; lint 0 errors; plan check PASS. The run exited 1 because vitest reported one unhandled error (a worker failed to start for lib/__tests__/api.test.ts: "Timeout waiting for worker to respond"). Classified INFRASTRUCTURE_FLAKE: that file passes in isolation (6/6). Earlier, a manifest-native failure under load was likewise classified a flake (passed in isolation). A clean exit-0 run in CI before merge is recommended.
evidenceThisPass.IMAGE_SECRET_SCAN: No credentials in the built image; the only prefix matches are Zod startsWith("whsec_") validators.
evidenceThisPass.LEGACY_CHECKOUT_ROUTE: POST /api/payments/checkout/create returns 500 on staging, creates no Stripe session, leaves the dues row pending (fails closed).
evidenceThisPass.SCOPE_CORRECTION: Member dues removed from the launch contract; dues initiation routes gated (501 unless UE_MEMBER_DUES_PAYMENTS=1) with 22 tests including a negative control; Stripe secrets are optional in the manifest and the template (enableStripe=false by default).
evidenceThisPass.FIRST_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP: PASS: 5 unit + 9 native tests on real PostgreSQL with the canonical schema; the race test fails without the advisory lock.
evidenceThisPass.RESTORE_TOOL: scripts/production/prepare-bootstrap-restore.ts reproduces the Azure-proven restore byte for byte (identical SHA-256 for schema and receipt) and is unit tested.

secretManifest.name: database-url
secretManifest.systemOfRecord: Key Vault (value generated at role creation; role lives in PostgreSQL)
secretManifest.rotation: 90 days; create the new password on the login role, set a new Key Vault version, restart the revision
secretManifest.notes: Non-superuser login role, no BYPASSRLS; tenant isolation depends on it.

secretManifest.name: system-database-url
secretManifest.notes: NOINHERIT login role that may only SET ROLE union_eyes_system.

secretManifest.name: pg-admin-password
secretManifest.notes: Never injected into the app. Operator access is through a temporary in-VNet host.

secretManifest.name: auth-secret
secretManifest.rotation: Annually or on suspicion; rotation signs every user out

secretManifest.name: mfa-encryption-key
secretManifest.rotation: NOT ROTATABLE with the current code: stored TOTP secrets are encrypted with it and there is no re-encryption path (risk R-11)
secretManifest.notes: 32 random bytes. Back up the Key Vault version; losing it locks out all MFA users.

secretManifest.name: cron-secret
secretManifest.rotation: 90 days; the app and the cron job read the same secret and restart together

secretManifest.name: redis-url
secretManifest.systemOfRecord: Key Vault (rediss://:<access key>@<host>:10000); key from Azure Managed Redis
secretManifest.rotation: 90 days; regenerate the secondary key, publish the URL, restart, then regenerate the primary
secretManifest.notes: Required runtime dependency; rate limits fail closed without it.

secretManifest.name: stripe-secret-key
secretManifest.rotation: Use a restricted live key (rk_live) limited to PaymentIntents; roll every 90 days with Stripe rolling-key expiry (applies only if client-commercial billing is enabled)
secretManifest.notes: OPTIONAL at initial launch: Stripe is post-launch client-commercial enablement. No live key is provisioned and no live charge is authorized. Not referenced by the template unless enableStripe=true.

secretManifest.name: stripe-webhook-secret
secretManifest.rotation: On endpoint secret roll; the route verifies one secret, so roll in a quiet window and restart immediately (risk R-12) (applies only if client-commercial billing is enabled)
secretManifest.notes: OPTIONAL at initial launch: Stripe is post-launch client-commercial enablement. No live key is provisioned and no live charge is authorized. Not referenced by the template unless enableStripe=true.

secretManifest.name: resend-api-key
secretManifest.rotation: 90 days; create the new send-only key, publish, restart, then revoke the old key
secretManifest.notes: Production-specific send-only key restricted to the verified sending domain.

secretManifest.name: storage-account-key
secretManifest.rotation: 90 days; alternate key1/key2 so the old key stays valid until the restart completes
secretManifest.notes: @nzila/blob signs SAS URLs with the account key and has no managed-identity path (risk R-8).

secretManifest.name: pii-encryption-key
secretManifest.systemOfRecord: Key Vault RSA key; app identity holds Key Vault Crypto User
secretManifest.rotation: New key versions only after a re-wrap plan exists; never delete the old version
secretManifest.notes: Created by the runbook; not rotated without a re-encryption procedure.

secretManifest.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secretManifest.rotation: Only when the Stripe account changes
secretManifest.notes: Not required: no member-facing payment page is mounted. Only needed if a client payment page is enabled.

riskMatrix.risk: Rate limiter failed open when Redis was unreachable (ioredis pipeline errors were dropped)
riskMatrix.control: FIXED this pass: adapter propagates per-command errors; proven fail-closed on staging (409 before, 429 after)

riskMatrix.risk: A stuck Redis command hung every org-scoped request until the app was restarted after an outage
riskMatrix.control: FIXED this pass: bounded store timeout (2s, RATE_LIMIT_STORE_TIMEOUT_MS), ioredis commandTimeout/connectTimeout, and the client is discarded and recreated after a timed-out command. Proven on staging with no app restart: recovered 26s after Redis returned (an earlier revision that only called disconnect() did not recover)

riskMatrix.risk: Production credential copied into staging
riskMatrix.control: REMOVED this pass: staging-specific send-only key, old versions disabled, app secret replaced, key fingerprints differ

riskMatrix.risk: Production PostgreSQL private connectivity: legacy production is on a public endpoint with AllowAllAzureServices
riskMatrix.control: V2 template: VNet-injected server, private DNS, no public access, no firewall rules; the runbooks use an in-VNet operator host
riskMatrix.residual: Open until the V2 stack is deployed (template compiled and linted, not deployed)

riskMatrix.risk: Front Door is Standard: no managed WAF rule sets and no Private Link; the legacy app FQDN is reachable directly (WAF bypass)
riskMatrix.control: V2 env is internal; required: upgrade the profile to Premium, add Private Link origin and the Microsoft default + bot rule sets in Prevention

riskMatrix.risk: Registry has admin credentials enabled, is Basic, public, and shared by staging and production
riskMatrix.control: V2 pulls by managed identity (AcrPull); required: disable admin after staging apps move to identity pull, import by digest, preferably a dedicated Premium registry
riskMatrix.residual: Supply-chain exposure while admin stays enabled

riskMatrix.risk: Release source is an uncommitted working tree; no CI-built, signed artifact exists
riskMatrix.control: Release image is PENDING_CI_MERGED_SOURCE. Required: commit, PR with the repository checks, merge, CI build from the protected branch, promote by digest. The final source digest is recorded in the ledger.
riskMatrix.residual: Digest below is a candidate only

riskMatrix.risk: Storage uses a shared account key; @nzila/blob has no managed-identity or user-delegation SAS path
riskMatrix.control: Private endpoint only, key only in Key Vault, rotation runbook, versioning and soft delete
riskMatrix.residual: Key compromise requires network access first; managed-identity support is backlog

riskMatrix.risk: Production schema bootstrap execution (the V2 installer is local-only by design)
riskMatrix.control: PROCEDURE_APPROVED: CANONICAL_BOOTSTRAP_V2 as a verified restore of the qualified candidate. RUNBOOK_DATABASE_BOOTSTRAP.md has preconditions, exact commands, expected results, verification, rollback and stop conditions; the restore tool reproduces the Azure-proven restore byte for byte

riskMatrix.risk: First administrator for the new production database
riskMatrix.control: ENGINEERING PASS: operator-only tool (no HTTP surface, no default identity or password), one transaction under an advisory lock, idempotent, canonical audit, enrolled MFA, refuses when any administrator exists. Proven on real PostgreSQL with the canonical schema (9 native tests, race test fails without the lock). RUNBOOK_FIRST_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP.md

riskMatrix.risk: The MFA encryption key cannot be rotated (no re-encryption path)
riskMatrix.control: Key held only in Key Vault with purge protection; documented as non-rotatable
riskMatrix.residual: Compromise would force an MFA re-enrollment of all users

riskMatrix.risk: Stripe webhook route verifies a single secret, so a secret roll briefly rejects events (relevant only if Stripe is enabled)
riskMatrix.control: Roll in a quiet window and restart; Stripe retries failed deliveries for up to three days

riskMatrix.risk: CLIENT_COMMERCIAL_PAYMENT_STRATEGY: whether Stripe must be active at initial launch
riskMatrix.control: RECLASSIFIED. R-13 = POST_LAUNCH_COMMERCIAL_ENABLEMENT. Member dues collection is out of launch scope, the dues payment UI is not built, the dues Stripe flow is a dormant optional capability (501 unless UE_MEMBER_DUES_PAYMENTS=1), and no initial-launch journey depends on Stripe. See COMMERCIAL_STRIPE_BOUNDARY.md
riskMatrix.residual: None for launch; live Stripe configuration becomes a gate only if a client-commercial payment is selected for the initial rollout

riskMatrix.risk: Legacy POST /api/payments/checkout/create returned 500 under V2
riskMatrix.control: CLOSED: it now answers 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED while member dues payment is not enabled (auth first, then 501; no database or provider access); covered by tests

riskMatrix.risk: /api/health is shallow: it returned 200 while Redis was down
riskMatrix.control: Dependency alerts (Redis, ClamAV, database, Stripe, Resend) and the go-live smoke probe dependencies directly
riskMatrix.residual: Container probes do not detect dependency loss

riskMatrix.risk: No log signal for ClamAV outage or cron dead-lettering
riskMatrix.control: ClamAV: replica-count metric alert; cron: job-failure alert (pattern unvalidated until first run) plus the Resend-failure alert and a daily dead-letter SQL check

riskMatrix.risk: Nothing schedules the deadline-reminder cron in production
riskMatrix.control: Template defines a Container Apps job (5 minute schedule) with the secret from Key Vault; needs a curl image imported into the registry

riskMatrix.risk: Cutover from the legacy production UE stack
riskMatrix.control: DECISION_CLOSED: INITIAL_CUTOVER = RUN_ALONGSIDE (no big-bang replacement; the legacy stack keeps serving its users). Cutover conditions: new stack healthy, authentication healthy, tenant isolation verified, first admin established, providers healthy where required, audit persistence healthy, synthetic production smoke clean, rollback available

riskMatrix.risk: Server feature profile
riskMatrix.control: CLOSED_PRODUCT_DECISION: PRODUCTION_SERVER_PROFILE = internal (the qualified profile). executive is post-launch

riskMatrix.risk: Production restore time is unmeasured at production size (staging drill: 7 minutes for a B1ms server with synthetic data)
riskMatrix.control: PITR with 35 day retention and geo-redundant backup in the template; run the same drill after the first deployment

internalReleaseBlockers.definition: Real A/B defects or an unproven exact-source regression; operational and human gates are listed separately in goLiveOperationalGates

goLiveOperationalGates.gate: Production PostgreSQL private connectivity: legacy production is on a public endpoint with AllowAllAzureServices
Front Door is Standard: no managed WAF rule sets and no Private Link; the legacy app FQDN is reachable directly (WAF bypass)
Registry has admin credentials enabled, is Basic, public, and shared by staging and production
Release source is an uncommitted working tree; no CI-built, signed artifact exists
Production schema bootstrap execution (the V2 installer is local-only by design)
First administrator for the new production database
Cutover from the legacy production UE stack
Production secret provisioning in the new Key Vault (the manifest lists what is required and what is optional)
Production DNS, certificate and provider setup (Resend production key and sending domain; Stripe only if client billing is selected)
Merge, production deployment and customer-data authorizations
